title: Desert Bloom
description: Nermin is putting a lot of work into taking care of that flower...

mainQuestExcel.title: Desert Bloom
mainQuestExcel.description: Nermin is putting a lot of work into taking care of that flower...

dialogs.text: Whew... Loosening the soil like this should work...
Are you still looking after this flower?
Yep. Granny Kulsoom gave me a lot of tips on taking care of flowers.
Things like loosening soil, regularly trimming leaves, getting rid of bugs using various methods...
Oh, and you shouldn't water them too often, or else the roots will rot.
*sigh* And I thought watering them every day was the way to go... To keep the soil moist and stuff...
But it's a good thing, because I don't have to fetch water everyday anymore. The stepwell's really far away.
I have to continue trimming the leaves. In the meantime, could you fetch a small can of water for me?
I've talked to Kazan. He said I could water the flowers today.
Leave it to me.
The watering can is over there. Be careful when drawing water. Don't let too much mud get into the can!
Granny Kulsoom taught you all that?
Mm... Kinda. Granny Kulsoom knows everything. I always go to her when I have questions.
I'm counting on you! One small can of water will do.
Oh no... There's more bitten leaves...
What happened?
Traveler, look! That kitten is chewing on my flowers again!
Look at this leaf over here... That one too! They all have large chunks bitten off!
Perhaps the kitten is hungry.
That's also what Raef said. He even went around to feed the kitten...
But the next day, the kitten came back to nibble on my flowers.
The kitten just munches on leaves for now. What if it starts biting the stems? ...That would be a disaster.
But I don't want to chase it away either. If it leaves the village, it'll have nowhere to go but to the desert...
Traveler, could you help me feed the kitten again? I hope it doesn't come nibbling at my flower leaves again. They're not even tasty to begin with...
Leave it to me.
Anyway, thanks for agreeing to help. I'll mark the kitten's favorite spot on your map...
Meanwhile, I'm gonna stay here and watch my flowers in case another little cat comes along and takes a chunk off the leaves...
I'm somewhat of a cat expert.
That would be great! Whenever I see cat paws, I'm worried that the cat'll pounce at me with its claws out...
Perhaps the kitten... enjoys chewing on plants?
I'm not sure what it likes...
Traveler, perfect timing! Come have a taste of the Minty Bean Soup I made.
The ingredients in your soup...
I asked someone to buy most of the ingredients for me, but as for Mint... I grew them myself.
Raef gave me a set of gardening tools and some fertilizer.
I thought it would be a waste to use them on one single pot of flowers... So I asked Azalai to buy some Mint seeds for me.
After planting the Mint seeds, I took care of them just like how I take care of the flowers.
As time went on, the Mint grew and matured...
So I picked some and made this Minty Bean Soup. What do you think? Tastes pretty good, huh?
Um... Since you ate my Minty Bean Soup, you have to do me a favor.
Uh, I'm not done eating yet...
Hey, I was just joking! I'll give you a nice reward for your help.
I just need you to pick three Zaytun Peaches for me. They're Raef's favorite fruit.
I wanna add them to my Minty Bean Soup and bring it to him.
Now that I know how to make Minty Bean Soup, I just need someone to get the Zaytun Peaches for me.
Got it...
Thanks! I'll treat you to another bowl of Minty Bean Soup when you get back.
I'm counting on you, Traveler. Find some Zaytun Peaches and bring them back to me.
Is he allowed to eat soup while at work?
It's not gonna take up that much of his time. Besides, he's not too busy with work.
You can take this bowl back!
Huh, why is there another batch of goods coming in all of a sudden...
Ugh... Why are there so many bugs on the leaves?
Ugh... Why are there so many bugs on the leaves?

flow.stepDescription: Go back and water the plants

dialogs.text: Did you fetch the water?
If this counts...
Great! I'm gonna start watering the flowers. Please wait a second...
Nermin starts watering the flowers...
Whew. This should do it...
Granny Kulsoom says that when you're watering plants, you should stop when the water starts seeping out from below the flower pot.
Because that means the soil has been "soaked through." You need to water them once every three days...
Ah! Sorry, I got carried away... Here's the reward I promised. Thank you for helping out, Traveler.
Which tool should I use for trimming leaves...
Meow? Meow meow meow!
Whoa! We aren't bad guys! Don't get so worked up!
This should be the cat Nermin was talking about. Let's give it some food.
You place the food in front of the wary cat.
It really likes the food. Paimon guesses this will do. Let's report back to Nermin.
Why does the kitten like nibbling on leaves...? I wonder what they taste like...

It really likes the food. Paimon guesses this will do. Let's report back to Nermin.
Why does the kitten like nibbling on leaves...? I wonder what they taste like...
Traveler, did you find the kitten?
I gave it some food.
Great! I hope it doesn't mess up my flowers again... Cat food is supposed to taste better than flower leaves, after all.
Thanks for your help, Traveler. Here, this is your reward.
*sigh* I hope the kitten doesn't get hungry too soon...
I think the kitten's full now.
Thank you. I need to cut them into pieces, then put them in my Minty Bean Soup...
Nermin starts making her special Minty Bean Soup...
Done! Hmm... It doesn't look any different than the regular Minty Bean Soup...
But I'm sure it's gonna taste different!
Traveler, please bring this bowl of Minty Bean Soup to Raef.
I have to make a few more servings for Granny Kulsoom. Ebeid and Hilmi said they wanted to try some too...
Don't overexert yourself.
I won't! It's just a few bowls of Minty Bowl Soup, not a big deal at all!
Anyway, please bring this Minty Bean Soup to Raef.
I have to prepare some for Nawaz and Ramiz as well...
You seem so energetic...
Well... Since I'm finally able to actually do something meaningful, I have to make the most out of it.

flow.stepDescription: Bring the drink Nermin made to Raef

dialogs.text: I have to prepare some for Nawaz and Ramiz as well...

flow.stepDescription: Bring the drink Nermin made to Raef

dialogs.text: Minty Bean Soup... Did Nermin make this herself?
So that's why she's been acting all mysterious lately. I heard that she bought a few flower pots, too... I wondered what she planted in them.
Not that it's a bad thing. At least she won't be spending all her time worrying about her health.
There's still another batch of goods I need to take care of. Once I bring them back into the village, I'll try her soup.
Oh, and here's a little something for you. Thank you for coming all the way here.
I have to prepare some for Nawaz and Ramiz as well...
Traveler, have you found the Zaytun Peaches?
Hey Traveler! Didn't expect to see you here. Do you need any help from me?
Nermin wants to give you this.
